tools.name: find_dinners
tools.description: Find upcoming The Dinner Table Club dinner parties for strangers, filtered by city and date range. Each result has the restaurant, neighborhood, local date and time, price per person (dinner included), whether seats are left, and a link to the event page where tickets are sold. Cities: New York (NYC), Washington DC, Los Angeles (LA), Miami. San Francisco is coming soon.

city.description: Which The Dinner Table Club city to search. Omit for all cities.

start_date.description: Earliest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, in the city's local time. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: Latest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, in the city's local time. Omit for no end date.

include_sold_out.description: Include sold-out dinners (they have a waitlist). Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum number of dinners to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_dinner_details
tools.description: Get full details for one The Dinner Table Club dinner returned by find_dinners: the event description with the restaurant and menu as listed, plus answers to common questions (coming solo, age, what the ticket includes, dietary needs, bringing a friend, cancellations).

dinner_id.description: The id of a dinner from find_dinners.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities where The Dinner Table Club hosts dinners, whether each is live or coming soon, and how many dinners are on the calendar.
